Class MoleculeMediaExport

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.export.MoleculeMediaExport
public final class MoleculeMediaExport extends Object
Manages asynchronous media export jobs, frame dispatching, and background encoding threads.

Capture stays on the render thread; bounded background encoding never waits in a render tick.
